copy.headline: Man in custody after allegedly shooting wife, hours-long standoff in Arlington, police say
copy.caption:
WATCH: Man in custody after allegedly shooting wife, hours-long standoff in Arlington, police say

Arlington police said officers were called to the home on Templeton Drive for a reported shooting.

Video: CBS Texas on YouTube

story.title: Man in custody after allegedly shooting wife, hours-long standoff in Arlington, police say
story.summary: Arlington police said officers were called to the home on Templeton Drive for a reported shooting. When they arrived, they found a 57-year-old woman outside with a gunshot wound to her leg.
